COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
17.03.2026 WPMB No.146 of 2026
M/s Prince Construction Company --Petitioner 
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & Ors. --Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. J.C. Pandey, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. The submission of learned counsel for the 
petitioner is that in exactly identical facts and 
circumstances WPMB No.58/2026, WPMB No.64/2026, 
WPMB No.65/2026, WPMB No.66/2026 and WPMB 
No.71/2026 are pending and in which interim orders are 
also in operation to the effect that work orders shall not 
be issued. 
4. Learned State Counsel very fairly states that, the 
work in respect of which present writ petition has been 
filed, is subject matter of WPMB No.64/2026 and, 
wherein issuance of work order has been stayed.
5. Connect with WPMB No.58/2026, WPMB 
No.64/2026, WPMB No.65/2026, WPMB No.66/2026 
and WPMB No.71/2026 and list along with these writ 
petitions on 16.04.2026.
6. Counter affidavit, if any, be filed by the State in 
the meantime. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.) 
 17.03.2026 17.03.2026
Rajni
